mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REVIEW_WISHLIST (WISHLIST_NO, REVIEW_NO, MEMBER_NO) VALUES (SEQ_REVIEW_WISHLIST_NO.NEXTVAL, #{reviewNo}, #{memberNo})
mapper.select: SELECT R.REVIEW_NO AS "reviewNo", R.TITLE AS "title", R.RATING AS "rating", R.IMAGE_URL AS "imageUrl", W.CREATED_AT AS "createdAt" FROM REVIEW_WISHLIST W JOIN COMPANION_REVIEW R ON W.REVIEW_NO = R.REVIEW_NO WHERE W.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ORDER BY W.CREATED_AT DESC
